subject: Discrepancy: Acme (AWS Marketplace) — missing payout & VAT records
messages:
From: Amy Turner <amy.turner@acme-corp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in Oct marketplace payout

Hi Tessa,

We're still seeing a shortfall on the October marketplace payout from AWS. Per our AP team the remittance received on 2026-10-15 is ~USD 34,200 less than the invoice run (see attached). We believe the difference relates to two items:

- A set of line items that appear as "merchant withheld" in the AWS statement but that we never received a corresponding credit or explanation.
- VAT handling: some invoice lines show EU VAT withheld by marketplace; Acme is expecting a gross payout and will reclaim VAT separately.

I've attached: acme_invoices_oct2026.csv (invoice lines we sent) and a PDF export of the AWS seller statement for 10/2026. Can you confirm receipt and advise next steps?

Thanks,
Amy Turner
Head of Finance — Acme Analytics
amy.turner@acme-corp.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: acme_invoices_oct2026.csv, acme_aws_seller_statement_202610.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Amy Turner <amy.turner@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in Oct marketplace payout

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and attachments. We received the CSV and the seller statement. I'm escalating this to finance and our marketplace ops team so we can gather evidence for AWS.

A few asks to speed triage:
- Can you confirm the Seller ID shown on the AWS statement (we need the Marketplace Seller ID and the Account Number).
- If you have a CSV export of the marketplace with the marketplace_fee / withholding_flag columns that would be very helpful.
- Please confirm whether Acme expects a gross payout (Redwood to invoice the full amount) or whether you've already accepted marketplace-withheld VAT as final for your GST/VAT reporting.

We will:
1) run a diff between your invoice lines and the AWS metering report;
2) open a marketplace support case (we may need to attach both seller statement and metering deltas);
3) share a timeline with you within 48 hours.

cc: Logan (Finance) and Vanessa (Revenue Ops) for internal coordination.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Revenue Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in Oct marketplace payout

Tessa — thanks. Seller ID on the statement is 987654321. I've attached the AWS CSV export (includes marketplace_fee and withholding columns) and our AP remittance advice.

We want Redwood to pursue the missing payout with AWS; Acme will handle VAT reclaim separately once gross cash is delivered. Please escalate — our EOM close is next week and this shortfall creates a significant variance.

Regards,
Amy Turner
Head of Finance — Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme_aws_seller_statement_202610.pdf, acme_aws_export_202610.csv

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discrepancy in Oct marketplace payout — Acme / AWS evidence

Forwarding Acme's data. Initial read: there are a handful of duplicate usage IDs and several lines flagged by AWS as "seller withheld (tax)" which should not have reduced gross remittance to Acme without a corresponding credit memo.

Action items (internal):
- Logan: run a line-level reconciliation between Acme's invoice CSV and our AWS metering logs for seller 987654321. Look for duplicate usage ids and timestamp boundary issues (EOD shifts).
- Vanessa: prepare the consolidated evidence bundle for the marketplace support case (CSV diffs, seller statement, Acme remittance). Add a narrative that VAT was withheld by marketplace for EU flows.
- Please flag any rows that would trigger a payout correction vs rows that are legitimate marketplace fee adjustments.

I'm looping you both in — please reply with ETA and any early wins.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discrepancy in Oct marketplace payout — Acme / AWS evidence

Quick summary of my reconciliation (attached meter_diff_202610.csv):
- Found ~312 lines where usage_id was duplicated in our ingestion; duplicates cluster around 2026-10-01 23:58:xx UTC — likely a timezone / rollover bug in one of the collector shards.
- ~45 lines show marketplace_withholding_tag = TRUE in AWS export but Acme's invoices record them as grossable. Those lines are mainly EU-region SKUs.
- Net effect matches the ~USD 34k variance when duplicates are excluded and withheld lines are left uncredited.

Recommended next steps:
1) Open AWS Marketplace support case with: meter_diff CSV, Acme statement, AP remittance advice. Ask for (a) reversal of accidental duplicate deductions and (b) confirmation of VAT withholding rationale and route for seller reclaim.
2) Request an interim manual credit to Acme if the support timeline exceeds 10 business days.
3) If AWS indicates marketplace policy requires seller-level VAT handling, coordinate with Acme finance for reclaim steps and share documentation.

I'll prepare the ticket bundle; Vanessa, can you assemble the narrative and sign off on evidence?

— Logan
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Amy Turner <amy.turner@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Billing <marketplace-billing@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy in Oct marketplace payout — next steps and ticket opened

Amy — quick update and proposed timeline.

We opened a marketplace support case (Ticket MN-4529) and attached: Acme seller statement, Acme invoice CSV, our meter_diff_202610.csv, and the AP remittance advice you provided. We've asked AWS to:
- Confirm whether the duplicate usage_id rows were applied by AWS ingestion and request reversal if so.
- Explain the VAT withholding entries and provide guidance on whether a payout correction or seller reclaim is required.
- Provide an ETA for a decision and any interim manual credit (requested within 10 business days).

What we need from you to move faster:
- Signed copy of the Master Partner Agreement (we have a DocuSign stub link but need a PDF) — this helps escalate with Marketplace Ops.
- Any bank remittance details Acme prefers if a manual credit is issued.

I'll follow up as soon as we hear from AWS. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute call with Acme finance + our marketplace ops team tomorrow to walk through the evidence.

Thanks for your patience — we're prioritizing this.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Revenue Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwood.com
